biggest_catch: Both sides only get $25, and the friend's account must stay open and unrestricted until payout - close or restrict it and the bonus is gone.
catches: Referring member receives a $25 bonus in the form of a gift card (Visa or Amazon.com e-gift card) per valid referral; friend receives $25 too.
Friend must be a new member, open a Smart Money Checking or Money Market Select account, and maintain a $5 minimum balance for 30 days.
Reward redemption emails sent within 5 business days of meeting offer requirements; account must not be closed or restricted at payout.
Referrer must be a Westerra member in good standing; all participants must be US residents 18+.
Bonuses subject to verification and reportable for tax purposes; no cap stated on the official page.
Offer subject to change or end at any time.
